summary: Top Ships Inc. (CIK 0001296484) filed a Form 6-K on May 15, 2026, disclosing its decision to withdraw its previously announced $10 million public equity offering. The related registration statement on Form F-1 (File No. 333-295332) was filed on April 27, 2026, but was never declared effective, and no securities were sold. The company states the withdrawal was because it determined not to proceed with the offering at this time. No financial terms, premiums, advisors, or board recommendations are disclosed. This is a withdrawal of a proposed offering, not a special situation, and does not involve M&A, activism, restructuring, or other categories. The filing is a routine update on an abandoned capital raise.
